name: Google Doc & Drive File Lesson Reader
description: Fetches the full UTF-8 plain text of a teacher's shared Google Doc, Google Drive PDF, Word DOCX, or TXT file ('Anyone with the link can view') given its share URL or Document/File ID.

args.description: Full Google Docs or Drive share URL (https://docs.google.com/document/d/... or https://drive.google.com/file/d/...), direct document link (.pdf, .docx, .txt), or bare Document/File ID.
